The '''Matcha Flavoured Wiki''' is an unofficial encyclopedia of the [[Matcha Flavoured]] datapack, modeled on the Minecraft Wiki. It is not made or endorsed by the pack's developer.

== Sources ==
Every article is written from primary sources: the pack's own repository (datapack functions and JSON, and the resource pack's language file) at a fixed commit, the official release notes on Modrinth, and the developer's videos. Where the code and the notes disagree, the wiki describes the code. Many tables, such as recipes, loot and trades, are generated directly from the data, and the "Source" links in references point to the exact files in the repository. The wiki describes the latest release, {{Current version}}, together with the bug fixes already on the repository's <code>main</code> branch.

== How it is written ==
The articles are generated by a large language model from the sources above, and a second pass checks each one against them. Nothing is taken from other wikis, forums or other people's videos: if a fact can't be found in the pack's files, its release notes or the developer's videos, it stays out. References point to the exact file each fact comes from, so anyone can check it.

The tables of recipes, uses, loot, trades and item stats aren't written at all. Scripts read them straight from the pack's data files, so they always match what the pack ships.

The wiki keeps up with the pack on its own. Every day it checks the pack's repository, its release notes and the developer's channel. When something changes, the tables are regenerated and the articles the change touches are revised and checked again.

It was started by one player who wanted a complete reference for their own game. Mistakes are still possible. If you find one, use the '''Talk''' tab on the page to report it.

For a wiki written by players, see [https://matchaflavoured.wiki/ matchaflavoured.wiki], the community wiki that players write and edit together.

== Credits ==
* This wiki was set up after [https://matchaflavoured.wiki/ matchaflavoured.wiki], with the same skin (legacy Vector) and URL scheme. Its logo, which is also the site's icon, and the background of the main page's update banner are matchaflavoured.wiki's. 14 of this wiki's 16 Lua modules (Addcommas, AnimateSprite, Array, Hatnote, Inventory slot, Mainonly, Mw.html extension, Paramtest, ProcessArgs, Round, SpriteFile, TSLoader, UI and Yesno) and its animated-icons script are copied from it. matchaflavoured.wiki in turn took those modules from the [https://minecraft.wiki/ Minecraft Wiki], the [https://runescape.wiki/ RuneScape Wiki] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/ Wikipedia]; most modules name their origin at the top.
* The skin's stylesheets and interface images are the Minecraft Wiki's own.
* Textures, icons and station screens come from the Matcha Flavoured resource pack, and from vanilla ''Minecraft'' where the pack does not replace them. See [[Credits]] for the people behind the pack.
